quote.text: The only letter about money my parents actually finish.

sections.title: Advisory practice
sections.description: SEBI-registered investment adviser to sixty households, fee-only, no commissions and no product sales. Taking four new families a year.

items.title: Financial plan
items.text: A written plan for your household: goals, insurance, investments and tax, reviewed with you in two sessions.

items.title: Ongoing advice
items.text: Quarterly reviews, rebalancing calls and a WhatsApp line for the questions in between.

items.title: Second opinion
items.text: One session on a portfolio or a policy you already hold, with a written note after.

items.label: First call
items.text: Thirty minutes, free. We talk about where you are and whether I am the right adviser. Often I am not, and I will say so.

items.label: The plan
items.text: Two working sessions and a written plan within three weeks. Every recommendation says what it costs you and why.

items.label: After
items.text: You implement on your own platforms; I never hold your money. Reviews every quarter, more often in a bad year.

items.question: Do you earn commissions?
items.answer: No. I am fee-only: the fee is the whole of what I earn, so no product I suggest pays me anything.

items.question: Do you work outside Bengaluru?
items.answer: Yes. Most sessions are on video; about a third of the families I advise live in other cities.

items.question: Is there a minimum portfolio size?
items.answer: No minimum. The plan is about the household, not the size of the portfolio.

sections.title: The Sunday clinic
sections.description: A free money clinic for gig workers, every Sunday morning in Indiranagar. Two hours, no appointment, whatever you want to ask. Running since 2022.
